name: Rosewood Mayakoba

address.street: Ctra. Federal Cancún-Playa del Carmen Km 298

insider_take: Where jungle meets sea in Mexico's most exclusive eco-paradise, Rosewood Mayakoba redefines luxury through authentic Mayan heritage and pristine natural beauty.
whats_special: This ultra-luxury resort sits within a 1,600-acre nature preserve on the Riviera Maya, featuring overwater lagoon suites - a rarity in Mexico. The property seamlessly blends into its environment with traditional Mayan architecture, cenote-fed lagoons, and the only overwater spa in Latin America. Each suite comes with a private dock and direct lagoon or beach access.
pro_tip: Book the Overwater Lagoon Suite for sunrise yoga on your private deck, then kayak directly from your suite through mangrove channels to spot pink flamingos and sea turtles.
dont_miss: The cenote-inspired spa treatments in overwater pavilions, private beach dinners under ancient cecropia trees, and the resort's signature experience - exploring the underground river system that connects to the ancient Mayan underworld, accessible only to Rosewood guests.
pros: Stunning overwater suites with direct lagoon access
Exceptional spa treatments in jungle and cenote settings
World-class dining with beachfront and fine dining options
Pristine private beach with crystal-clear Caribbean waters
